title: Paid seven one-dollar bills
summary: Paid at the end of the night in seven dollar bills, he lays the money out for his wife.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I don't remember. Up until the day, I don't remember. The only thing I remember about him, he was a bass player. He was a tall, tall dogfella. But I always, in all these years, I always tried to find out the man's name, but the way I describe him to people, nobody seems to know who I'm talking about. You see? And so, I'll finish to tell you that. The big thing came off when he said, well, it was time to pay me off. So when the man got ready to pay me off, he had, what seemed to have nothing but one dollar bills in his hands, you know? So he said, well, I didn't pay, I said, all right, come on, go ahead and get your money. So he started to pay me off. He handed me a dollar, and he handed me another dollar, and he handed me another dollar, you know? Couldn't believe it. So after he got up to about three dollars, I started to draw my hands back. He said, come on, get your money. So he handed me another dollar. You see? And every time he'd hand me a dollar, I'd draw back. So he'd hand me another dollar. So he kept on handing me until he had handed me seven dollars, you know? So he handed me seven dollars. I just stood up and looked, and just froze, you know? I couldn't move. So he said, come on, man, put your hand money in your pocket and let's go. Man, my pocket, you might not believe it, but I was holding money all the way.
Man, my pocket, you can't get your hand money in your pocket.

That's the truth. So when I got home that night, the party we had played, the people had fixed sandwiches and everything that we could take home. And I got home. Well, everybody knew I was in there because it looked like the door wasn't big enough for me to get in there, you see? So when I got there, I told my wife, I said, look here. She said, what's that? I said, look what that man played me for playing tonight. So we just sit down there and just spread the money out. Like a big sheet, just stood up and look at it.
You didn't even want to take the job.
